en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ahmad b. Musa (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Harun al-Sufi narrated to us. He said: `Ubaydullah b. Musa al-Ruwayani narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-Athim b. `Abdullah b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Zayd b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) narrated to me from Ibrahim b. Abi Mahmud.

He said: `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) said, regarding the saying of Allah, "The faces on that day will be bright, looking at their Lord" (75:22-23). He said: Meaning, [their faces will be] illuminated, looking at the rewards of their Lord.
